sourceText:
Gari Foto
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 12:12am

Ingredients




1 ounce Palm oil
1 medium Onion -- chopped
2 Tomatoes -- peeled and
Chopped
6 ounces Carrots -- chopped
6 ounces Mushrooms -- chopped
6 ounces Green chile -- chopped
1/2 pint Vegetable stock
4 ounces Gari

Preparation

1 (Gari is a coarse-grained roasted, grated fermented flour, made from cassava and used as a staple food in a similar way to ground rice) 2 Cook the onion and tomatoes in the margarine or palm oil, stirring until pulpy, in a non-stick saucepan. Add carrots and fry for a few minutes. 3 Stir in the palm oil, then add the mushrooms, green peppers, stock and hot pepper. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Mix the gari into the sauce in handfuls, stirring constantly until all the liquid is absorbed.
